triage.note: The mutation half of ui-font-link-nonblocking, in the S5 `-regression` shape (expect.min_failures == max_failures pins an EXACT count, so a regressed miss and a regressed over-fire both go red). The fixture carries eight links and exactly three must fire: (3) a second external sheet with the media/onload attributes removed — the 'attribute removed' and 'second blocking link' mutations are the same tag; (4) a `media=print` sheet with no onload, which never applies on screen; (7) the same blocking link written with UNQUOTED attribute values (PR #33 R1 — valid HTML that the quoted-only ATTR_RE never saw, so the tag was skipped as 'not a stylesheet'). The five that must NOT fire are the shipped fix itself, its `<noscript>` fallback, a same-origin sheet, an HTML-commented-out link, and (8) a `media="not all"` sheet promoted by `this.media='ALL'` (PR #33 R2 — `not all` is the other standard non-blocking idiom and media values are case-insensitive; both were false positives before round 1). A check that pinned the literal attribute string instead of the property would count (1) green by accident and (4) green by mistake; this fixture is what says it does neither.

provenance: S3 follow-up PR #33, created 2026-08-22, alongside the check.
